parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign) WHERE c.status = 'active' RETURN c.id as campaignId, c.name as campaignName, c.worldState as worldState, c.lastHealthCheck as lastHealthCheck, c.systemMetrics as systemMetrics

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) SET c.lastHealthCheck = '{{ $json.timestamp }}', c.healthMetrics = {{ JSON.stringify($json.health_summary) }}, c.monitoringHistory = COALESCE(c.monitoringHistory, []) + [{{ JSON.stringify({ monitoring_id: $json.campaignId + '_' + $json.timestamp, health_summary: $json.health_summary, alerts: $json.alerts, notifications: $json.notifications }) }}] RETURN c

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, monitoring_id: $json.monitoring_id, campaign_id: $json.campaign_id, health_status: $json.health_summary.overall_health, performance_score: $json.health_summary.performance_score, alerts_generated: $json.monitoring_cycle.alerts_generated, notifications_sent: $json.monitoring_cycle.notifications_sent, recommendations: $json.recommendations, next_steps: $json.next_steps, compliance_status: $json.compliance_status.status, processing_time: $json.monitoring_cycle.processing_duration, timestamp: $json.processing_time } }}
